description: Search for stops by name or code. Returns matching stops with IDs and coordinates. Use to resolve a human-readable stop name or number to a stop ID for arrivals lookups with onebusaway_get_arrivals.

maxCount.description: Maximum number of results to return. A positive integer, at most 100. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Stop name fragment or stop code (e.g. "University Way" or "75403").

name: onebusaway_search_stops

cap.description: The maxCount limit applied to truncated results.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitExceeded.description: True if more stops match than were returned; raise maxCount or refine the query to see all.

notice.description: Guidance when no stops matched — e.g. try a different name fragment or use onebusaway_find_stops with coordinates.

query.description: Search query sent to the API.

shown.description: Number of stops returned when results were truncated.

items.description: A transit stop with location and route information.

code.description: The stop code printed on the sign.

direction.description: Compass direction of travel at this stop.

id.description: Agency-prefixed stop ID (e.g. "1_75403"). Use with onebusaway_get_arrivals.

routeIds.description: IDs of routes that serve this stop.

truncated.description: True when matching stops exceeded maxCount.

title: Search Stops by Name or Code
